| description = A drunk who wanders between two bars and the Temple of Brell in [[Thurgadin]].

Horasug begins in the Temple of Brell standing on a bench, facing the wall {{Loc|Thurgadin|-295, 762|(-295, 762)}}.

He walks a short distance to the nearby '''The Holy Harbinger''' {{Loc|Thurgadin|-365, 448|(-365, 448)}} and begins the following exchange:

: Horasug says 'My beloved brethren! Hear me now, I have seen a sacred vision...'

: Rumagur says 'Hey Fronden, I want a double of whatever you've been serving him!"

: Saramor says 'Blasphemer!'

: Horasug says 'In my vision, Brell himself spoke to me! He indicated that the path to true enlightenment could only be found through sobriety. Substances such as alcohol only serve to cloud the mind and keep us from our true destiny!'

: Loremaster Fronden raises an eyebrow at Horasug.

: Horasug says 'Mock me if you will brothers. I am off to seek audience with the Dain where I will convince him of the evils of liquor. I am sure he will have our taverns serving only water and juice by day's end.'

: Jorumin says 'Over my dead body!'

: Saramor says 'Get him boys!'

: Horasug says 'Uh oh'

Horasug runs out the door while Rumagur, Jorumin, and Saramor give chase. They soon stop chasing him.

Upon escaping to '''Doogle's Drinks''' {{Loc|Thurgadin|-68, -306|(-68, -306)}}:

: Horasug says 'Whew, that was a close one!'

: Doogie McBanick says 'Hello there, Horasug! What brings ya here?"

: Horasug says 'I had a sacred vision from Brell himself!'

: Doogie McBanick says 'A vision you say? What exactly was this a vision of?'

: Horasug thinks for a moment, looking at the roomful of rugged patrons,

: Horasug says 'Heh, I saw meself here at Doogie's Drinks partaking of the finest Coldain ale in the land of course!'

: Doogie McBanick says 'Well, you came to the right place, Horasug. A few of these ales will fill you with all the visions you can handle.'
